{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Achieving energy independence will not be easy, but is possible, as demonstrated by the moon landing.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Drilling will not achieve energy independence.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States must invest in research and development and deployment of renewable energy technologies such as solar, wind, and geothermal.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States must invest in technologies to store energy through advanced batteries and clean up coal plants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will call on businesses, government, and the American people to make America 50 percent more energy efficient by 2030.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A more energy efficient economy will gain a competitive edge for new manufacturing and jobs that stay in the United States.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Funding for these initiatives will be partially provided by dedicating a portion of the revenues generated by an economy-wide cap and trade program.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An economy-wide cap and trade program will dramatically reduce greenhouse gas emissions.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An economy-wide cap and trade program will jumpstart billions in private capital investment in a new energy economy.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
